name: Word and Character Counter
title: Word Counter and Character Counter with Platform Limits
description: Count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs, estimate reading time, and see how your text fits limits for meta descriptions, X posts and LinkedIn. Runs in your browser.
card: Count words and characters and check common length limits.
lede: Paste or type text to get word, character, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, and how close you are to common length limits.
answer_q: How do I count words and characters?
answer: Paste your text here; words, characters with and without spaces, sentences, paragraphs and reading time update as you type. Emoji and accented letters count as one character each.
steps: Read the counts at the top.
Check the bars for the platform you are writing for.
Use the most used words list to spot repetition.
Clear and start again with one click.

examples.title: Meta description check
examples.text: A 172 character description shows as over by 12 against the 160 character guidance, so trim a clause before publishing.

faq.q: How is reading time worked out?
faq.a: Word count divided by 238 words per minute, a commonly cited average silent reading speed for adults reading non-fiction.

faq.q: Do emoji count as one character?
faq.a: Here, yes. Some platforms count certain emoji as two characters, so leave a small margin under hard limits.
Runs of letters or numbers, using your browser's word segmenter where available. Hyphenated words and contractions count as one.
No. Nothing is saved or sent. Closing the tab clears it.
